name: Jain no Ikenie 2 ~Onna Yuusha to Shuudoujo - Hateshinaki Zecchou & Shokushu Jigoku ni Ochita Dark Elf to Seijo~
original_name: 邪淫のいけにえ2 ～女勇者と修道女・果てしなき絶頂＆触手地獄に堕ちたダークエルフと聖女～
source:
At some point, the Tentacle Princess, Altea, began ruling the world, spreading terror and despair.  
But a girl received a divine oracle to defeat her and save the world.  
Her name is Rigel, the Hero.  
Alongside her battle sister, Capella, Rigel sets off into the deep forest where Altea’s castle is said to be.  
Unaware that a trap of humiliation and depravity awaits them…  

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ013053.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
在某个时刻，触手公主阿尔特亚开始统治世界，散布恐惧和绝望。
但一个女孩收到了神谕，打败了她并拯救了世界。
她的名字是英雄瑞吉尔。
瑞吉尔与她的战斗妹妹卡佩拉一起出发，前往据说阿尔特亚城堡所在的森林深处。
却没有意识到，等待着他们的是羞辱和堕落的陷阱……
